outer_cv: 3 repeats of duration-stratified 5-fold; same auction assignments across feature groups and stages; items modeled separately
tuning: None; fixed settings. B7 exploratory, not used for claims of confirmed significance.

definitions.recent_new_bidders: Unique known bidders in (cutoff-0.1*duration, cutoff] absent from all bids at or before window start
definitions.recent_active_bidders: All unique known bidders in recent window; distinct from truly new bidders
definitions.hhi_change: Recent-window bidder HHI minus preceding adjacent window bidder HHI; empty window HHI defined as zero, interpret together with counts
definitions.price_lift: Maximum recorded prefix bid minus opening bid; not necessarily public standing price
definitions.rating_missing_share: Among identified prefix bidders; missing bidder identities separately counted

limitations: No calendar timestamps: not forward chronological validation
Ratings may be collection-time snapshots; historical availability unverified
Same bidder can occur in different auctions; no bidder-disjoint validation
Repeated CV and exploratory bootstrap not independent final confirmation
No fraud labels or causal identification; price/currency provenance unverified
Earlier analyses already examined this dataset
